init.title: Battery reserve control
init.description: Protect a minimum battery reserve with the lowest selected SOC. Configure the complete daily curve below; both points are connected linearly across 24 hours.

data_description.reserve_enabled: When enabled, Fsolar will automatically change output source priority on every inverter.
data_description.reserve_soc_entities: All selected sensors must be available and report a value from 0 to 100.

data_description.reserve_point_a_low: At this SOC or lower, every inverter changes to UTI to protect the reserve.
data_description.reserve_point_a_high: At this SOC or higher, every inverter changes to SBU and the battery becomes available.

data_description.reserve_point_b_low: At this SOC or lower, every inverter changes to UTI to protect the reserve.
data_description.reserve_point_b_high: At this SOC or higher, every inverter changes to SBU and the battery becomes available.

error.soc_entities_required: Select at least one battery SOC sensor before enabling control
error.reserve_times_must_differ: Points A and B must use different times
error.point_a_high_must_exceed_low: At point A, the Solar/Battery/Utility threshold must be greater than the Utility first threshold
error.point_b_high_must_exceed_low: At point B, the Solar/Battery/Utility threshold must be greater than the Utility first threshold
